title: the AVX2 reference set is stale - 26 test models and 4 mini examples fail under exudynCPPfast
author: Claude-JG
description: AVX2ReferenceSolutionUpdate (recorded 2026-09-17) was not renewed when the regular reference values moved (modified Newton default #2815 and others), so the fast-module suite of the 1.13 release failed on 3.10 and 3.13; re-recorded from the fast logs of cp310 and cp313, which agree to the last digit
releaseNotes: the AVX2 reference set re-recorded from the fast-module suite on cp310 and cp313 (identical); contactFrictionCircleCable2DnoFrictionTest takes 1000 steps, so Newton converges and both modules agree; the mini example ObjectConnectorRigidBodySpringDamper has one value for both modules; runPerformanceTests.py applies the AVX2 set to its single runs. revision2026b step RG2.7
